pages.raw_meta: Sulfur Solutions for Clean Fuels and Critical Materials
raw_blocks: Driving Progress by Delivering Reliable Sulfur Solutions for Clean Fuels and Critical Materials
Our suite of sulfur products and services, strengthened by a family of leading brands, powers critical industries and essential applications worldwide.
A Platform of Leading Sulfur Solutions
Our long history of innovation, expertise and close customer collaboration supports the development of our products and services across our company.
Ecoservices provides sulfuric acid regeneration, produces virgin sulfuric acid, and offers chemical waste handling and treatment services.
Calabrian produces high-value sulfur dioxide and derivative solutions, enabling us to serve a broader set of essential industries.
Chem32 sulfides and activates catalysts for refining and renewable fuel processes.

We are a leading sulfuric acid regeneration provider. Our expertise in sulfuric acid processing and extensive plant network enable us to provide end-to-end regeneration services to support alkylate production for more than 75 years.

We are a leading North American producer of specialty grade high-purity virgin sulfuric acid for a number of diverse and growing end uses. Among them are mining, particularly copper for electronics applications, production of lead acid batteries for all types of vehicles, water treatment, and agricultural products.

We offer reliable chemical waste handling and treatment services from four of our facilities. Thanks to our extensive experience in the treatment and disposal business, Ecoservices facilities can accommodate a diverse array of pumpable wastes.
Chem32 sulfides and activates catalysts and absorbents which are used in refining, petrochemical and environmental processes, using its proprietary THIOCAT® fixed-bed sulfiding technology.

Our Calabrian business supports customers’ needs for a reliable supply of ultra‑pure sulfur dioxide and related derivatives. We deliver high-purity solutions that meet rigorous performance and quality standards across water treatment, mining, energy, and other specialty applications.
Building Momentum Towards a More Sustainable Future

Sustainability is intertwined with our daily business and is reinforced through our strategy and values. We strive to create sustainable products that are safe for the environment, reduce waste and increase efficiencies for our customers and stakeholders . Our products contribute to cleaner air, support the energy infrastructure, and ensure clean, purified drinking water. We are committed to creating environmentally responsible products that make a difference in people’s daily lives and for our planet .
Read our 2025 Sustainability Report
We believe that each of our team members drive meaningful impact .

At Ecovyst, we strive to develop our people, who in turn drive our ability to advance new solutions for our global customers . We encourage you to browse our current openings and consider joining our team.

pages.raw_title: Who We Are | Our Company Values | Long-Term Sustainability
pages.raw_meta: Learn about key background details of the company including our corporate values and committment to long term sustainability.
raw_blocks: Backed by an over 130-year history, Ecovyst has evolved into a family of leading sulfur brands united by a shared commitment to reliability, innovation, and performance. We have carefully cultivated our reputation as a premier provider of virgin sulfuric acid, sulfuric acid regeneration services, and sulfuric acid derivatives. Our company has longstanding customer relationships, and our products and services play an essential role in our customers’ operations and industrial processes. We support our customers’ growth, while enabling the expansion of forward-looking technologies such as the production of cleaner-burning fuels and the mining of minerals such as copper, that are essential in broader electrification and the global expansion of data centers.

We have a strong financial profile and a proven history of favorable cash generation that provides for significant capital allocation flexibility as we look to expand our business as we support the rapidly evolving needs of our customers.

A key component of this evolution is the new addition of the Calabrian business, a leading producer of sulfur-based specialty chemicals. This acquisition furthers Ecovyst’s capabilities into sulfur dioxide and related derivatives, enabling us to expand and serve a broader set of essential industries. Calabrian further enhances Ecovyst’s role as a trusted partner in advancing critical industrial and environmental applications through our sulfur expertise.

At Ecovyst, we are accelerating the implementation of our growth strategies while maintaining our focus on efficient and reliable operations to support our customers’ needs for critical product and services.
A Platform of Leading Sulfur Solutions
Our longstanding customer relationships, industry expertise and broad geographic network position us for continued growth across our portfolio of products and services.

As a leading producer with an extensive history and significant expertise in the production of sulfuric acid and sulfuric acid regeneration, we are also a premier provider of sulfur-related technologies and services and related derivative products. Through our regeneration services business, we provide end-to-end recycling of spent sulfuric acid for our refining customers’ production of alkylate, a critical fuel blending component necessary to meet more stringent fuel specifications and provide for higher fuel efficiency and lower emissions.

We provide specialty grade high-purity virgin sulfuric acid for a number of diverse and growing end uses. Among them are mining, particularly copper for electronics applications, production of electric vehicles and the ongoing expansion of data centers across the globe, and industrial applications including our customers’ production of nylon precursors, production of lead acid batteries for all types of vehicles, industrial and municipal water treatment, and refining and petrochemical processes.
CHEM32 sulfides and activates catalysts for refining and renewable processes.
Through our Calabrian business, we are also a leading-provider of sulfur dioxide and derivative products used in mining, water treatment and specialty chemical applications.
Together, as a family of sulfur brands, we deliver the scale, expertise, and innovation our customers need.
Ecovyst is Serving Long-Term Sustainable Trends

Our portfolio continues to aggressively minimize the environmental impact of our footprint and operational network, and we are intently focused on efficient and reliable operations to support our customers’ performance requirements and serve their long-term growth and sustainability objectives.

We are particularly proud of our health and safety performance and are unwavering in our commitment to the health and safety of our employees, contractors, the communities in which we operate and our customers.
As we support our customers in achieving their own sustainability goals, we anticipate improving our environmental performance and have implemented a comprehensive set of sustainability goals.
Learn more about work on sustainability

We believe that each of our team members can drive meaningful impact. As a company with a global reach, complemented by strong local presence, we help our customers solve complex challenges-—always with safety and environmental stewardship at the forefront of our minds. Our core values guide us in these endeavors:
Stewardship We aim to create positive and sustainable impacts by exercising safe and responsible stewardship over our resources, products and operations.

High Standards We strive to outperform the highest standards by regularly challenging the norm and seeking continuous improvement across all our operations. This is how we deliver world class results.
Integrity We pledge an uncompromising commitment to honesty and ethical conduct in the performance of our work and across all interactions with key stakeholders.
Engagement We are driven to passionately seize opportunities and lean into challenges to achieve Ecovyst’s goals of delivering unparalleled products and services to our customers.
Our Impact - Supporting the Needs of Today and the Future

We continuously strive to be better stewards of our environment and the communities in which we operate. We do this through meaningful community engagement and by supporting our internal teams to do their best work while maintaining a healthy balance between their professional and personal lives.
Learn more about our social responsibility work
